# Azure SQL

Monitors database health — DTU/CPU, connections, deadlocks, storage, and query latency — reading from **AzureSQL_CL**.

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
AzureSQL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize
    AvgDtu    = avg(DtuPercent),
    MaxDtu    = max(DtuPercent),
    AvgCpu    = avg(CpuPercent),
    MaxCpu    = max(CpuPercent),
    P95Worker = percentile(WorkerPercent, 95)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, DatabaseName, Environment
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: DTU / CPU % Over Time

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
AzureSQL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize
    AvgActiveConn   = avg(ActiveConnections),
    MaxActiveConn   = max(ActiveConnections),
    TotalFailedConn = sum(FailedConnections)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, DatabaseName, Environment
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Active & Failed Connections Over Time

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
AzureSQL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize TotalDeadlocks = sum(DeadlockCount)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, DatabaseName, Environment
| where TotalDeadlocks > 0
| order by TotalDeadlocks desc
content.title: Deadlocks Over Time

content.query:
AzureSQL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, StoragePercent, StorageUsedMB, StorageLimitMB)
    by Resource, DatabaseName, Environment
| extend Severity = case(
    StoragePercent >= 90.0, "Critical",
    StoragePercent >= 80.0, "Warning",
    "OK")
| project Resource, DatabaseName, Environment,
          StoragePercent, StorageUsedMB, StorageLimitMB, Severity,
          LastReported = TimeGenerated
| order by StoragePercent desc
content.title: Storage Utilisation — Current Snapshot

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
AzureSQL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize
    AvgQueryMs = avg(QueryDurationMs),
    MaxP95Ms   = max(QueryDurationP95Ms)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, DatabaseName, Environment
| extend SloBreached = MaxP95Ms > 1000.0
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Query Duration P95 Over Time
